instance_id.title: Instance Id
instance_id.description: Unique identifier of the archiver instance.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle state of the instance: STOPPED, RUNNING, or UNREACHABLE.

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname of the machine the archiver process is running on. Null if never started.

pid.title: Pid
pid.description: OS process ID of the running archiver binary. Null if not running.

db_backend.title: Db Backend
db_backend.description: Database backend the instance is configured to write to (e.g. sqlite, postgres, mssql).

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the instance was last started.

last_heartbeat.title: Last Heartbeat
last_heartbeat.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the archiver's last self-reported heartbeat.

assigned_partitions.title: Assigned Partitions
assigned_partitions.description: JSON-encoded array (string) of Kafka partitions currently assigned to this instance.

record_count.title: Record Count
record_count.description: Total number of records archived by this instance.

shutdown_requested.title: Shutdown Requested
shutdown_requested.description: Flag (0/1) indicating a graceful shutdown has been requested.

auto_restart.title: Auto Restart
auto_restart.description: Whether the supervisor should automatically respawn this instance if its process dies.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: Reason the archiver gave for its own exit (watchdog stall, sustained write failures, ...). Cleared on the next start; null for a deliberate operator stop or an unexplained crash.

schema.title: ArchiverInstance
schema.description: Represents an archiver instance from the fleet registry.

400.description: Instance cannot be started in its current state.

500.description: Failed to spawn the archiver binary.
